name: paper-book-traces
description: 纸质书阅读痕迹：记录书、页码、批注、重读与读完后的情绪。

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @paper-book-traces/api" "npm run dev -w @paper-book-traces/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @paper-book-traces/web && npm run build -w @paper-book-traces/api
scripts.test: npm run test -w @paper-book-traces/api && npm run test -w @paper-book-traces/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:test -w @paper-book-traces/api && npm run typecheck -w @paper-book-traces/web
